character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A jagged, asymmetrical hair cut with a sharp split-color scheme—deep amethyst purple on the left and vibrant toxic green on the right. The texture is wild and wind-swept.  Intense and defiant expression. Her eyes are sharp, framed by heavy dark eyeliner and a focused brow.  She wears a layered ensemble of charcoal-grey distressed fabrics. A sleeveless leather vest with silver studs sits over a tattered tunic. Heavy-duty silver chains are wrapped loosely around her waist and shoulders.  Tall, scuffed black leather combat boots with multiple silver buckles and thick platform soles.  A blackened, gnarled wooden staff. At its apex, a core of violet energy erupts into a steady, crackling purple flame that illuminates her silhouette.
